summary: Genius Sports Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, containing an interim report for the three months ended March 31, 2026, and a press release announcing first quarter 2026 financial results. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is indicated. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results by a foreign private issuer, corresponding to a US quarterly earnings release. The report does not propose any transaction or corporate action that would constitute a special situation.
